about_the_game:
The street is your restaurant. You’ll have to be fast to win!

Food Cart, Inc. is a fast food management simulation where you take your mobile food cart and chase fame across the big city.

From downtown streets to carnival zones, from university campuses to busy airports — set up your cart, collect orders, prep your ingredients, and most importantly… don’t keep the customers waiting!

Features:

✔ Real-time cooking
Chop ingredients, grill meat, fry potatoes, and deliver the order right on time!

✔ Expanding city map
Serve in city centers, beaches, carnivals, stadiums, universities and more — each with unique customer types.

✔ Revenue management
Earn money, manage your ingredient stock, and purchase licenses to unlock new districts.

✔ Mastery system
The more you cook specific dishes, the better you become. Mastery increases tips and builds your fame.

✔ Rising challenge
Expect more customers, more complex orders, and tighter time limits as you progress.

✔ Goal-oriented progression
Each region unlocks with new missions and achievements to conquer.

Food Cart, Inc. is both a time-management game that challenges your reflexes, and a strategy game that rewards smart planning.
With vibrant visuals, themed zones, and fluid mechanics, it’s as fun as it is satisfying.

Are the meals ready? Your next customer has just arrived.

See You at the Cart!

If you like Food Cart, Inc., don’t forget to add it to your Steam Wishlist to be notified when the full version launches!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Food Cart, Inc. is a fast food simulation game where you run a mobile food cart, focused on real-time cooking and quick service. Move your cart across different city zones, prepare orders, pay rent, and try to keep your customers happy.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Finnish, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian
